talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 65 solo PCPs winding down in Georgia; 13 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Columbus 31904, Forest Park 30297, Stockbridge 30281) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~7,241 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Henry County, Atkinson County, Brooks County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 24 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~206,400 patients across 172 at-risk practices statewide.
